findings.title: During the regenerating state, the 'Generated by Plato' relative timestamp shows the NEW pending summary's age while the displayed content is still the prior review
findings.expected: While the prior review stays on screen during a re-score (SPEC 2.7), its 'Generated by Plato · about 1 hour ago' timestamp would keep describing the displayed (old) review.
findings.actual: Immediately after confirming, the header read 'Generated by Plato · less than a minute ago' while the headline/analysis/score were still the old seeded review (created ~1 h earlier). After completion the same timestamp correctly describes the new review.
